reuseDecision: Do not copy, port, translate, execute, or derive code from the unlicensed notebooks. Independently implement the published methods in TypeScript, retain method/run provenance, and seek legal advice before any other reuse.
requirements: No Hudson & Thames account, mlfinlab package, vendor code, broker, exchange, or external provider is required for an independent implementation.
For purging: each label must retain event start, event end, feature-lookback boundary, optional uniqueness weight, and immutable feature/label version metadata.
For triple barriers: locally licensed historical OHLC or finer data is required; close-only bars cannot resolve the first barrier hit. Make the bar-path convention explicit.
For PAPER backtest metrics: retain net-of-modeled-cost return paths, timestamps, all tried variants, observed return count, skewness, kurtosis, and a stated annualization convention.
For real L2 inventory-quote research: timestamped depth updates and an explicit PAPER fill/cost model remain necessary; quality historical depth may be paid or license-restricted.
Keep all owner data local and do not expose Composer credentials in Expo. Composer access requires credentials and a Pro account; official sources conflict on endpoint rate limits.
